text:
Ethan: Hey @people-ops — quick onboarding/payroll question. I submitted direct deposit during onboarding but want to confirm a couple things: 1) how do I check/change federal/state tax withholding (W-4 / state form) and when do changes take effect? 2) I start Oct 30 — how are holidays and PTO prorated for new hires? Also where do I submit expense receipts for reimbursement?

Sana: Welcome, Ethan! :wave: Short answers first: update W-4/state withholding in the HR portal and it usually takes effect the next payroll cycle after the payroll cutoff; holiday/PTO prorate depends on your start date and the policy (we pro-rate by days in the accrual period). Receipts go to Ramp/Expensify (we use Ramp for company card expenses, personal reimbursements go through Expensify). I can walk you through the exact steps.

Priya: Adding specifics — for federal withholding: go to the HR portal -> My Profile -> Tax Forms -> Edit W-4. For CA employees you also need the state withholding form (DE-4). For timeline: payroll cutoff is Fridays 5pm PT. Changes submitted before cutoff generally apply to the next pay run (so ~1 pay cycle). If you submit after cutoff it will apply the following cycle.

Sana: For bank details: HR portal -> My Profile -> Payment -> Direct Deposit. We accept multiple accounts (primary + optional savings). Upload a voided check or bank pre-auth if prompted. Example path in portal UI: `Settings > Payroll > Direct Deposit > Add Bank` — screenshot is in the onboarding guide.

Priya: PTO/holiday details: Our PTO accrual schedule is monthly pro-rated for first/last months. For company holidays that fall during your first partial month we prorate holiday pay based on your start date. Example: if a full month has 22 work days and you start on day 15, you'd get (remaining workdays / total) * holiday allotment for that month. If you want I can calculate for Oct 30 if you tell me your office location (state) and whether you are hourly or salaried.

Ethan: Thanks! I'm salaried and CA-based. So I should submit DE-4 even if I already did federal W-4, got it. One more: I gave a personal bank initially — can I switch to a different account before the first payday?

Sana: Yes, you can switch. Do it in the portal and confirm the status shows "Verified". If you're switching before the payroll cutoff tomorrow 5pm PT, it'll apply to the upcoming run. If not, it will apply to the next. PayrollBot can show upcoming cutoff info.

PayrollBot: Upcoming payroll cutoff: 2025-11-14 17:00 PT. Next pay date: 2025-11-21. Changes to direct deposit or tax forms submitted before cutoff will be included in next pay run.

Priya: For reimbursements (personal card / out-of-pocket): use Expensify, tag expense with project/team, attach receipt, and choose reimbursement method (ACH). Reimbursements typically hit in 5-7 business days after approval. For company card charges, finance handles reconciliations via Ramp — just add a note in the receipt that it's a company expense.

Ethan: Awesome, that's really helpful. One last logistics Q: who do I cc for urgent corrections if my bank routing was wrong?

Sana: If it's urgent, email people-ops@redwood.inference and cc payroll@redwood.inference — include your employee ID, the correct last 4 of the account, and a screenshot of the portal confirmation. We'll escalate.

Ethan: Perfect, sending now. Thanks both! :raised_hands:

Sana: np — welcome again! ping me if anything weird shows on your first pay stub. :thumbsup:
